1	/**
     2	 * Repo Status Cells Component — Repo Parallelizer GUI.
     3	 *
     4	 * Encapsulates the reusable Branch, Status badge, and Actions `<td>` cell-building
     5	 * logic shared between the workspace-detail and repository-detail views.
     6	 *
     7	 * ## Exported functions
     8	 *
     9	 * - `buildRepoStatusCells`   — Build the three `<td>` elements for a single
    10	 *   repository row (branch, badge, actions). Callers assemble the full `<tr>`.
    11	 * - `makeBranchTrigger`      — Build a `<button class="branch-switch-trigger">`.
    12	 * - `updateRepoStatusCells`  — Update branch and badge cells in-place within a
    13	 *   `<tr>`, locating them by CSS class (`.repo-branch-cell`,
    14	 *   `div[data-repo-id]`) rather than by hardcoded cell indices.
    15	 *
    16	 * @module repo-status-cells
    17	 */
    18	
    19	import { api }               from '../api.js';
    20	import { createStatusBadge } from './status-badge.js';
    21	
    22	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    23	// Public exports
    24	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    25	
    26	/**
    27	 * Build a branch-switch trigger `<button>` styled as inline text.
    28	 *
    29	 * Extracted to avoid duplicating the element setup in both `buildRepoStatusCells`
    30	 * (initial render) and `updateRepoStatusCells` (polling updates). The click
    31	 * handler is wired by the caller so it can close over a fresh `trigger`
    32	 * reference.
    33	 *
    34	 * @param {string} branchName - Branch name shown as the button label.
    35	 * @param {string} ariaLabel  - Accessible label for screen-readers.
    36	 * @returns {HTMLButtonElement}
    37	 */
    38	export function makeBranchTrigger(branchName, ariaLabel) {
    39	    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    40	    btn.type        = 'button';
    41	    btn.className   = 'branch-switch-trigger';
    42	    btn.textContent = branchName;
    43	    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', ariaLabel);
    44	    return btn;
    45	}
    46	
    47	/**
    48	 * Build the three shared status `<td>` cells for a single repository row.
    49	 *
    50	 * Returns a plain object with `branchCell`, `badgeCell`, and `actionsCell`
    51	 * so the caller can insert them into whatever `<tr>` it is constructing,
    52	 * interleaving its own cells (e.g. a repository name cell) as needed.
    53	 *
    54	 * @param {Object} opts
    55	 * @param {string}      opts.repoId      - Unique repository identifier.
    56	 * @param {string}      opts.repoName    - Human-readable display name; used in
    57	 *                                         aria-labels. Falls back to `repoId` when
    58	 *                                         the caller has no richer name.
    59	 * @param {Object|null} opts.statusInfo  - GitStatusInfo object from the API, or
    60	 *                                         `null` when no status data is yet available.
    61	 * @param {string}      opts.projectId   - ID of the parent project.
    62	 * @param {string}      opts.wid         - ID of the parent workspace.
    63	 * @param {boolean}    [opts.isStable]   - When `true`, the branch cell is rendered
    64	 *                                         as plain text (no clickable trigger).
    65	 * @param {function(HTMLElement, string, string): void} [opts.onBranchCellClick]
    66	 *                                         Callback invoked with `(anchorEl, repoId,
    67	 *                                         currentBranch)` when the branch trigger is
    68	 *                                         clicked. Only wired when `isStable` is falsy.
    69	 * @param {string|null} [opts.webserverUrl] - Base URL of the local webserver. When
    70	 *                                         truthy, a "Browse" button is inserted
    71	 *                                         before the "Git GUI" button inside
    72	 *                                         `actionsCell`.
    73	 * @returns {{ branchCell: HTMLTableCellElement, badgeCell: HTMLTableCellElement, actionsCell: HTMLTableCellElement }}
    74	 */
    75	export function buildRepoStatusCells({ repoId, repoName, statusInfo, projectId, wid, isStable, onBranchCellClick, webserverUrl }) {
    76	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    77	    // Branch cell
    78	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    79	    const branchCell = document.createElement('td');
    80	    branchCell.className = 'repo-branch-cell';
    81	
    82	    const currentBranch = (statusInfo && statusInfo.currentBranch) ? statusInfo.currentBranch : null;
    83	
    84	    if (!isStable && currentBranch && onBranchCellClick) {
    85	        const trigger = makeBranchTrigger(currentBranch, `Switch branch for ${repoName}`);
    86	        trigger.addEventListener('click', () => onBranchCellClick(trigger, repoId, currentBranch));
    87	        branchCell.appendChild(trigger);
    88	    } else {
    89	        branchCell.textContent = currentBranch || '—';
    90	    }
    91	
    92	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    93	    // Badge cell — wrapper <div> keeps data-repo-id so polling updates can
    94	    // locate and replace badge contents without touching the rest of the row.
    95	    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    96	    const badgeCell = document.createElement('td');
    97	    badgeCell.className = 'repo-badge-cell';
    98	
    99	    const badgeWrapper = document.createElement('div');
   100	    badgeWrapper.dataset.repoId = repoId;

1	/**
     2	 * Workspace Detail View — Repo Parallelizer GUI.
     3	 *
     4	 * Renders the full detail page for a single workspace inside a project:
     5	 *   - Workspace header: ID, description, breadcrumb link back to the project.
     6	 *   - Repository status table: one row per repository, showing current branch,
     7	 *     a color-coded Git status badge, an error/loading indicator for repos
     8	 *     with no status data yet, and an Actions column containing an "Open"
     9	 *     button that opens the repository in GitHub Desktop via
    10	 *     `api.workspaces.launch.githubDesktop(projectId, wid, repoId)`.
    11	 *   - Live polling: status badges refresh in-place via a 1-second countdown
    12	 *     interval that triggers a poll every 10 seconds. A visible countdown
    13	 *     label and a "Refresh Now" button provide user control. The interval
    14	 *     is cleared via the cleanup function returned from
    15	 *     `renderWorkspaceDetail`, which the router calls before navigating
    16	 *     away.
    17	 *   - Actions: "Open in VS Code" button (shown only when workspace is
    18	 *     initialised, dynamically added after a successful Setup — calls
    19	 *     `api.workspaces.launch.vscode`), "Switch Branches" navigation button,
    20	 *     "Rename Workspace" (disabled for STABLE), "Delete Workspace" (disabled
    21	 *     for STABLE).
    22	 *
    23	 * ## Router integration
    24	 *
    25	 * The view uses the same router-injection pattern as `project-detail.js`:
    26	 * `app.js` calls `setRouter(router)` before `router.start()`. The `_router`
    27	 * variable is null-guarded at every navigation site so the view remains
    28	 * functional in test contexts.
    29	 *
    30	 * ## Cleanup contract
    31	 *
    32	 * `renderWorkspaceDetail` returns a cleanup function. The router's `_render`
    33	 * method already stores and calls any function returned by a view. No changes
    34	 * to `router.js` are needed.
    35	 *
    36	 * @module workspace-detail
    37	 */
    38	
    39	import { api }               from '../api.js';
    40	import { showToast }         from '../components/toast.js';
    41	import { showConfirm }       from '../components/confirm-dialog.js';
    42	import { buildRepoStatusCells, makeBranchTrigger, updateRepoStatusCells } from '../components/repo-status-cells.js';
    43	import { createFormField, validateRequired, WORKSPACE_ID_PATTERN } from '../components/form-helpers.js';
    44	import { normaliseProject, normaliseWorkspace } from '../utils/normalise.js';
    45	
    46	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    47	// Router reference — injected from app.js via setRouter()
    48	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    49	
    50	/** @type {import('../router.js').Router|null} */
    51	let _router = null;
    52	
    53	/**
    54	 * Inject the router instance so workspace-detail can navigate on rename/delete.
    55	 * Called from app.js before the router starts.
    56	 *
    57	 * @param {import('../router.js').Router} router
    58	 */
    59	export function setRouter(router) {
    60	    _router = router;
    61	}
    62	
    63	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    64	// Constants
    65	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    66	
    67	/** Default polling interval in milliseconds (fallback when config fetch fails). */
    68	const DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 10_000;
    69	
    70	/** The workspace ID that cannot be renamed or deleted. */
    71	const STABLE_WS_ID = 'STABLE';
    72	
    73	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    74	// Normalisation helpers — imported from utils/normalise.js
    75	// extractRepoId and extractRepoName remain local (workspace-detail only).
    76	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    77	
    78	/**
    79	 * Extract a repository's ID from either a plain string or an object.
    80	 * The backend may return Repositories as an array of strings, an array of
    81	 * objects with `Id`/`id`, or an array of objects with `repositoryId`.
    82	 *
    83	 * @param {string|Object} repo
    84	 * @returns {string}
    85	 */
    86	function extractRepoId(repo) {
    87	    if (typeof repo === 'string') return repo;
    88	    return repo.Id || repo.id || repo.RepositoryId || repo.repositoryId || '';
    89	}
    90	
    91	/**
    92	 * Extract a human-readable repository name from a repository entry.
    93	 * Falls back to the ID when no name is available.
    94	 *
    95	 * @param {string|Object} repo
    96	 * @returns {string}
    97	 */
    98	function extractRepoName(repo) {
    99	    if (typeof repo === 'string') return repo;
   100	    return repo.Name || repo.name || extractRepoId(repo);
